messages:
Nora (People Ops): quick manager onboarding note — condensed checklist you can paste into the hire folder. :sparkles:

Cam (new manager): Thanks! Could we flag analytics + billing as day-1 musts?

Nora (People Ops): yep. condensed plan below (aim: reduce friction first week)
- Pre-day: confirm laptop, payroll forms done, invite to calendar.
- Day 1 AM: 30m team intros + 20m expectations with hiring manager.
- Day 1 PM: IT handoff (SSO, Slack, email, VPN, analytics read, billing read).
- Day 2: Repo access + security primer (15m), attach required attestations.
- Day 3: pick a small onboarding task (doc/bug) to ship.
- EOW: finalize 30/60/90 draft and schedule 30-day skip-level review.

Elliot (Hiring Manager): For analytics/billing: request via Access Portal and mark "urgent" for managers.

Zoe (IT): @Cam DM your corp email and I can pre-provision analytics & billing read. For SSH key: run
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "cam@redwood.com"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```
Paste pub key into Access Portal -> Tech Access. Tag #help-it if stuck.

Cam (new manager): Sent DM with email & key. Also planning weekly 1:1s + biweekly team retro.

Nora (People Ops): Great cadence. We recommend weekly 1:1s for first 3 months and skip-levels at 30/60. Templates: 30/60/90 + intro email available in onboarding repo (SSO).

onboard-bot: Reminder set: complete payroll and equipment confirmation (due in 48h).
